description: This file defines the KeyspacesClient class within the Aws\Keyspaces namespace, used to interact with the Amazon Keyspaces service. It primarily declares method signatures for various operations related to keyspaces, tables, types, and resources, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: KeyspacesClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Keyspaces, extending AwsClient to provide specific methods for the service.

methods.name: createKeyspace
methods.description: Creates a new keyspace in Amazon Keyspaces.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table within a keyspace.

methods.name: getKeyspaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a keyspace.

methods.name: getTableAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a table.

methods.name: getTableAutoScalingSettings
methods.description: Gets auto-scaling settings for a table.

methods.name: getTableAutoScalingSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets auto-scaling settings for a table.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves details of a user-defined type.

methods.name: getTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a user-defined type.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: restoreTable
methods.description: Restores a table to a previous state.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
